_about: Pre-fills for the CER's unclassified titles, written each night by kb/_cer_procedures.py from the procedures in kb/cer_procedures.json and the classifier. credential_reference.js pre-fills each row. A pre-fill no reason holds is also saved to kb_curation under its procedure's cohort (Open Asks Sheet 94 card 2, 2026-10-18); a held one waits for the curator's Save. Rows with a saved assignment are never here.

Introduction to Law Enforcement/Correcti.issuer: California Commission on Peace Officer Standards and Training (POST)
Introduction to Law Enforcement/Correcti.note: Industry Certification at Palo Verde with no named credential. The title is kept as written. POST is a weak guess because the row pairs with other law-enforcement rows. The corrections half could point instead to a CDCR/CPOST or BSCC academy near Blythe's prisons, so the issuer needs review.
